name: Possessed

features.name: Cross Wild
features.description: A wild at the joint turns the whole cross wild at x2.

features.name: xActivation
features.description: Respins that activate more of the grid.

review:
Possessed is a horror slot with a cross-shaped 3-6-6-6-3 grid. Wilds only land on the middle reel, and one at the joint of the cross turns the whole cross wild with a x2 multiplier. xNudge, xWays and Infectious xWays add more.

xActivation symbols trigger respins that unlock more of the board. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 50,000x cap and a fairly high 31% hit rate.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
